# algolia_synonym (Resource)

Manages a single Algolia synonym object in an index.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algolia_index" "example" {
  name                = "products"
  deletion_protection = false
}

# A two-way synonym: searches for any listed term also match the others.
resource "algolia_synonym" "example" {
  index_name = algolia_index.example.name
  object_id  = "phone-synonym"
  type       = "synonym"
  synonyms   = ["iphone", "ios phone"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_name` (String) The index that owns the synonym.
- `object_id` (String) Unique identifier of the synonym object.
- `type` (String) Synonym type.

### Optional

- `corrections` (Set of String) Corrections used by alternative correction synonyms.
- `input` (String) Base input used by one-way synonyms.
- `placeholder` (String) Placeholder token used by placeholder synonyms.
- `replacements` (Set of String) Replacement values used by placeholder synonyms.
- `synonyms` (Set of String) Synonyms used by regular and one-way synonyms.
- `word` (String) Base word used by alternative correction synonyms.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier in the form <index_name>/<object_id>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import a synonym using the form "index_name/object_id".
terraform import algolia_synonym.example products/phone-synonym
```
